purpose: Separate train-only coverage from global prior recalibration. The expanded context-only model is the only adoption candidate; small context-only is a diagnostic control, never a fallback winner.

train.base: E39 selected 512 weak sources; re-audit against every declared heldout text and retain only clean rows
train.isolation: Full corpus family separation plus exact, symmetric substring and edit-distance-at-most-one exclusions against all current corpus dev.tsv/test.tsv and E28 diagnostics before candidate export; no replacement after exclusion
train.supervision: Automatic weak labels, not reviewed gold; only expected candidates actually recalled inside the eligible pool; no reference injection or teacher call
train.loss: Mean gold cross entropy plus 0.01/2 times squared parameter norm
train.optimizer: Zero initialization, float64 full-batch L-BFGS-B, maxiter 200, ftol 1e-10, gtol 1e-7; final result only, no sweep

features: Only character bigrams/trigrams ending in the candidate and containing at least two real Han characters; 0..2 left Han context or BOS; no EOS. Counts divided by sqrt(candidate length). At least two distinct train families per feature. No single-character features, BOS-only unigram proxies, learned decoder-score coefficients or intercept.
scoring: Unchanged baseline total + 8*tanh(context-only linear score/8); stable ties and unknown ngrams contribute zero
eligibility: Same first-eight equal-length Han 2..24 slots/source protection as E43; no corrected/personal source rows; all candidate arrays retained
evaluation: Current production M19 exports and full-result identity checked. Reuse pinned E43 dev baselines since no core/asset changes. Known dev data, not a new blind test.
gate: Expanded model: per-domain top1/top5 nondecreasing, recall unchanged, character errors nonincreasing, combined top1 strictly increases; host additional P95 <=100ms. Small model result does not affect acceptance.
stopRule: A failed expanded dev gate ends this fixed trial, with all changes and losses archived; no parameter/retraining selection, old test opening or Android install. A passing gate still requires independent regression and Android lifecycle/cost validation.
release: Preserve rc.5, production source and resources throughout this offline trial
